subtopics: Range use in slicing and matching

content.intro: Learn Beginless and Endless Ranges through a visual model, a minimal Ruby example, and a practical check.
content.why_it_matters: Understanding beginless and endless ranges helps you write code that is easier to explain, test, and maintain. It also helps separate Ruby language guarantees from runtime assumptions, dependency behavior, and application-specific rules.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: Beginless and Endless Ranges helps you reason about open-ended range boundaries. In Ruby, prefer a small example whose inputs and expected result are easy to explain. This lesson connects the syllabus topic to practical code and highlights where assumptions or edge cases matter.

content_blocks.title: How to think about it
content_blocks.text: Begin by identifying the key rule: Open-ended range boundaries. Then connect it to Range use in slicing and matching. The remaining syllabus points—Infinite or unbounded collection concerns—are useful checks before applying this in a larger project.
